update_content.message: We're back to pure Bing.com API for the respect of your privacy.

extension_desc.message: Simple new tab with beautiful daily wallpaper. Start search with your favorite search engine.

wallpaper_permission_explanation.message: Ataraxia needs download access to save the image you selected and confirm where your browser saved it. Your browser controls the destination and any Save As prompt.

wallpaper_actions_offline.message: Image actions are unavailable while this page is offline.

wallpaper_actions_loading.message: Wait for the visible wallpaper to finish loading at your selected resolution.

wallpaper_desktop_apply_failed.message: The image was saved. The desktop wallpaper could not be set.

wallpaper_save_unconfirmed.message: The browser could not confirm that the image was saved.

wallpaper_save_failed.message: The image could not be saved. Check browser downloads and try again.

wallpaper_permission_declined.message: Download access was declined. Allow access to save the image.

wallpaper_permission_failed.message: Download access could not be requested. Try again.

op_search_prompt.message: Edit JSON config to adjust search engines. You can change the order / delete or add search engines.

op_quick_link_prompt.message: Customize the Quick Links to be displayed in the upper right.

op_custom_bkmk_prompt.message: Edit JSON to add links you want to display:

op_wallpaper_uhd_hint1.message: By default UHD wallpapers are loaded. Turn it off to load lower resolution images if you prefer a faster loading speed.

op_wallpaper_uhd_hint2.message:
Quote of the day may be blank. If that happens, hover the mouse at the center of the screen bottom, and click the link arised.
That will open a new tab with the Bing search results. Closing it and then open a new tab. If you still don't see the quote of the day, probably the feature just doesn't work in your environment. Turn it off.

op_wallpaper_desktop_install_hint.message: The Windows installer is in development. For an unpacked extension, build and register the helper, then choose Check again.

op_wallpaper_desktop_off_hint.message: Turning this off prevents new desktop wallpaper actions. A save or wallpaper change already started can still finish. You can cancel an in-progress save in the browser.

op_wallpaper_desktop_source_hint.message: The desktop uses the downloaded file directly. Moving or deleting the file may affect your desktop wallpaper.

op_wallpaper_desktop_verified.message: The desktop wallpaper helper is verified.

op_wallpaper_desktop_permission_required.message: Allow native messaging to verify the helper. Choose Check again to retry.

op_wallpaper_desktop_incompatible.message: The installed helper is incompatible. Update the helper and choose Check again.

op_wallpaper_desktop_timeout.message: The helper did not respond in time. Check the installation and choose Check again.

op_wallpaper_desktop_check_failed.message: Could not verify the helper. Check the installation and choose Check again.

op_wallpaper_desktop_unavailable.message: Desktop integration is unavailable until a compatible helper has been installed and verified. Image downloading works independently.

op_wallpaper_download_folder_hint.message: Leave empty to suggest your browser's Downloads folder. Your browser controls the final destination.

op_wallpaper_download_folder_invalid.message: Use a relative Downloads subfolder, such as Wallpapers/Bing.

op_show_clock_checkbox.message: Show a digital clock when opening a new tab

op_about_prompt.message: Ataraxia - Refreshing and surprising new tab experience.

op_saved_alert.message: Changes have been saved and will take effect when opening a new tab.

op_reset_default_confirm_alert.message: Are you sure you want to restore the default configuration?

op_reset_default_done_alert.message: Restored to default configuration. It will take effect when opening a new tab.

op_top_site_require_perm.message: Turning on this feature requires you to grant permission to read the list of most visited sites.

op_top_site_perm_fail.message: Authorization failed, feature cannot be turned on. Please try again and grant the permission.

quote_of_the_day_search.description: Placeholder text for the quote source when it's not available and links to the quote of the day search.
